summary_markdown:
The team discussed issues with historical data calibration, specifically regarding signal levels and session recalculation. It was determined that the model should be updated to reflect a fixed signal level of 78 for historical sessions, rather than requiring full reaggregation or recalibration.

Later, the focus shifted to reviewing staging analytics dashboards. Issues were identified where certain time periods showed missing data points (e.g., on ds=stage). The team confirmed that the model relies on session-based aggregation, and a fix was implemented for real-time unique counts.

The final decision was made to deploy the corrected model/data to production after verification of historical fixes up to October 20th.
decisions: The system will use a fixed signal level of 78 for historical sessions, avoiding full reaggregation or recalibration.
A flag should be set on sessions with 78 calibration to prevent unnecessary recalculation runs.
The corrected model and data must be deployed to production.
